name: Kullu Dussehra
description: A week-long festival at Dhalpur Maidan that begins on Vijayadashami, when hundreds of village deities are carried into Kullu.
note: Dates follow the lunar calendar; check the exact week locally.

name: International Shivratri Fair, Mandi
description: A week-long fair around Mahashivratri, with processions of local deities and folk performances.

name: Minjar Mela, Chamba
description: Chamba's harvest fair, which ends with a procession to the Ravi river.
note: Usually late July or early August.

name: Lavi Fair, Rampur Bushahr
description: An old trade fair where traders from Kinnaur, Lahaul and Spiti sell wool, dry fruit and horses.

name: Losar (Tibetan New Year), McLeodganj
description: Tibetan New Year celebrations around the Tsuglagkhang temple complex.
note: Dates follow the Tibetan lunar calendar.

name: Hadimba Devi Fair (Dhungri Mela), Manali
description: A three-day fair in the deodar forest around Hadimba temple, marking the goddess's birthday.

name: Ladarcha Fair, Kaza
description: Spiti's traditional trade fair, now a cultural festival with local music and crafts.

name: Phulaich (Ukhyang) flower festival, Kinnaur
description: Villagers bring wild high-altitude flowers down from the meadows to honour the dead and the local deity.
